==Standard dialogue==
* {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} Do you... seek a challenge? If you do, the Mimic will test your mettle.}}
* {{topt|Tell me about the Mimic.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about the Mimic.
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} The Mimic is... a casket. When you find treasure, perhaps you will realise your casket is the Mimic.}}
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} If so, the Mimic will reveal itself, and summon you to its arena, to fight.}}
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} If you are victorious, the Mimic will reward you with... things.}}
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} So, would you like the chance to face the Mimic? The rewards are... special.}}
** {{topt|Yes, I'd like to get Mimic challenges.}}
*** '''Player:''' Yes, I'd like to get Mimic challenges.
*** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} The Mimic is... pleased.}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|No, I don't think I want that.}}
*** '''Player:''' No, I don't think I want that.
*** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} You may find me here if you change your mind. The Mimic will wait.}}
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|What are you?}}
** '''Player:''' What are you?
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} As you see, I am... a casket. Some of us are not mere vessels of wealth.}}
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} Some of us speak. Some can walk. And some, like the Mimic... can fight.}}
** {{topt|Tell me about the Mimic.}}
*** {{tact|above}}
** {{topt|I don't think I want that.}}
*** {{tact|below}}
* {{topt|I don't think I want that.}}
** '''Player:''' I don't think I want that.
** {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} The Mimic is... disappointed.}}
** {{tact|end}}

===If the player has a Mimic in their inventory===
* {{tbox|pic=Casket (easy) detail.png|{{Colour|#0000FF|Strange casket}} The Mimic has... found you! Will you fight now?}}
* {{topt|Fight the Mimic}}
** {{tact|The player enters [[The Mimic]]'s arena.}}
** {{tbox|If you {{Colour|#7f0000|die}} in here, your items can be retrieved from the {{Colour|#7f0000|Strange Casket}} in Watson's house, for a {{Colour|#7f0000|fee of 90,000 coins}}. Anything else you leave in here will be {{Colour|#7f0000|lost permanently}}.}}
